brief.subject: EUDR Brief: Commissioner at EUDR event, EU forest data
brief.headline: Quiet EUDR Day: Commissioner Attends Event as EU Publishes Forest Figures
brief.dek: An EU Commissioner attended an EUDR event, and new Commission figures put EU forest cover at about 39% of total land.
brief.lede: No new EUDR guidance, deadlines or enforcement actions appeared in today's sources. The Commission did note a Commissioner's attendance at an EUDR event and released EU land and forest figures.

sections.heading: Commissioner Attends EUDR Event
bullets: An EU Commissioner attended an EUDR event, according to a Commission environment newsroom post dated 2026-10-27.
The post gave no details on new guidance, deadlines or enforcement, so current compliance plans stand unchanged.

sections.heading: EU Forest Cover Holds at 39%
bullets: EU forest cover has stabilised at approximately 39% of total land, per Commission figures.
26.4% of total EU land is designated as protected.
81% of protected EU habitats have a poor or bad conservation status.
These figures concern forests inside the EU, not the producer-country supply chains that EUDR due diligence covers.

brief.seo_description: EUDR brief for 2026-11-02: an EU Commissioner attends an EUDR event, and Commission data show EU forest cover stable at about 39% of land.
